pins.n: Bank (Porter-Hensley block), Rice Lake (1893 fire map)
pins.v: Coins, tokens, tools, buttons
pins.st: The 1893 Sanborn fire insurance map of Rice Lake draws this building (Bank (Porter-Hensley block)) on sheet 3. In-town lots are usually built over or paved since; look for the lot, the alley behind it and any strip of old lawn or boulevard that was never dug.
pins.t: Turn on the Fire maps view to see the whole block as it was. Alleys, back lots, hitching posts, the edge of the old boardwalk and the ground by the doors and wells got the most losses. Get the owner's permission; city land needs a permit.
